description: Use this when the user wants a PNG and SVG QR image that displays plain text when scanned. Accepts up to 1,500 characters, preserves whitespace, and reports contrast, density and optional print width. Encoded UTF-8 content must fit 1,273–2,953 bytes depending on error correction. Static codes only; does not read QR images or make barcodes or Wi-Fi codes.

error_correction.description: Damage tolerance, e.g. M: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30%. Use H for printed codes that may get scuffed or carry a logo sticker.

foreground.description: Code (module) colour as hex, e.g. #111111 (default). Dark colours scan best. Basic colour names like navy or black also work.

scan_distance_cm.description: Optional distance in centimetres from which people will scan the printed code, e.g. 300 for a poster across a room; used to recommend a minimum print size.

text.description: Plain text to encode, up to 1,500 characters; whitespace is preserved. Example: Table 12 - ask for the specials.

name: generate_text_qr_code
title: Generate text QR code
